as_told.title: Colonel Alexander saw two Nordics in a Las Vegas casino hotel

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast, says that John Alexander told many interesting stories. One, according to Jorjani, involved seeing Nordics, beings said to look like tall humans and to talk by telepathy, at a hotel casino in Las Vegas, which, if true, would mean such beings walk among ordinary people.
